# Origin UI Pricing Plan Selector (Example 166)

Compare available plans and choose a pricing tier.

## Installation

- Copyable Origin UI compositions and their primitives; only apps/origin MIT files are imported.
- Use Tailwind CSS 4 with shadcn-compatible semantic colour tokens. File selection is presentation only: validate uploads on your server.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
